evidence_role: post-open source transfer diagnostic; not confirmation or a state-of-the-art claim

cohort.name: released PhysTwin 22
cohort.transfer_rule: all released PhysTwin-22 cases except the three named development cases

observation_path.metric_lift: each camera track is lifted through that camera's raw metric depth and frame-zero anchored
observation_path.prior_reliability: tracker quality, cycle consistency, and local depth variation only; independent of the PhysTwin innovation
observation_path.correlation_treatment: effective-sample cap within each camera and equal-weight covariance intersection across cameras
observation_path.nuisance_model: shared spatial bias plus per-camera bias

state_update.oversize_rule: deterministically shrink the inferred direction to the tighter physical cap; never widen the cap
state_update.scale_selection: lowest prefix validation Chamfer distance subject to no prefix regression
state_update.fallback: exact unchanged physical baseline when support, identifiability, update, or selector gates fail

calibration_boundary.required_before_fresh_evaluation: a separately locked source-only projection and coverage audit for the capped state posterior
calibration_boundary.claim: no future predictive calibration claim is made by this transfer diagnostic

decision.pass: authorize a separately locked source calibration audit and combination with the fixed graph-persistence baseline; do not open a fresh target yet
decision.fail: stop this per-view depth state-update family without retuning it on the 19 transfer outcomes

prohibited: using future RGB, depth, CoTracker, or VGGT evidence in prediction
changing the correction scales, rank, cap, or selector after transfer outcomes
calling the opened-cohort result confirmation or state of the art
touching held-v8 artifacts or any sealed target
